scripts.title: Humanoid HUB aimbot esp
scripts.features:
Dropping the V8.2 update for Humanoid Hub. I built this from scratch to be completely universal, so it should work on 99% of FPS and combat games on Roblox.

My main focus for this version was completely killing those annoying FPS drops and making sure the aimbot actually sticks to the head without spazzing out or shaking. It’s highly optimized.

Features:

Sticky Aimbot (RMB): Right-click to lock on. I added a custom deadzone and velocity prediction (0.045). It predicts where they are going, locks on smoothly, and doesn't shake when it reaches the head. Wallbang is supported.

Dynamic ESP: Boxes, Skeletons, Health bars, and Distance. The ESP is color-coded using raycasts: Red = behind wall, Green = visible, Cyan = currently locked target.

Team Check: Universal team check is enabled for both ESP and Aimbot so you don't snap to your own teammates.

Zero Lag Scanner: I removed the constant GetDescendants spam. It only scans when a new character actually spawns in, so your FPS stays maxed out.

Lite-Fullbright: Removes shadows and fog without deep-frying your screen into pure white.

Modal Cursor Fix: If you play games that force mouse-lock (like Frontlines, Arsenal, etc.), my custom UI bypasses it so you can actually click the menu buttons without your mouse getting stuck.

scripts.title: Humanoid HUB esp aimbot fov
scripts.features:
🌟 HUMANOID HUB V7.5 [UNIVERSAL ESP & AIMBOT] 🌟
The Ultimate Combat Suite for FPS & Action Games (Max FPS Optimized)

Humanoid Hub V7.5 guarantees 0% FPS Drops thanks to its built-from-scratch "Event-Based" scanning engine. Unlike classic cheats, it doesn't drain your CPU; it runs smooth as butter in the background. It features custom Velocity Prediction and Dynamic Wallcheck for the ultimate tactical advantage.

🎯 PREMIUM AIMBOT FEATURES
Sticky Hard-Lock: Once the aimbot locks onto a target (Right Click), it never flickers or switches targets even if someone else crosses your line of sight. It holds on until the enemy is dead!

Velocity Prediction: When the enemy is running or jumping, the aimbot doesn't lock onto where they are; it calculates their velocity and locks onto where they will be (0.045 prediction multiplier) for pinpoint accuracy.

Wallbang Supported: Even if your locked target goes behind a cover, the aimbot doesn't drop the lock. Works flawlessly for wall-banging.

Right-Click (RMB) Integration: No need to mess with keyboard binds. Just press and hold your Right Mouse Button to lock on like a laser.

👁️ DYNAMIC ESP (VISUAL SYSTEM)
Smart Color Shifting: Enemy boxes turn Red when they are hidden behind a wall, and glow Green the moment they are exposed and shootable.

Locked Target Highlight: The box of the enemy you are currently locked onto instantly turns Neon Cyan, so you know exactly who you are targeting in the middle of chaos.

Detailed Intel: Displays the enemy's health with a dynamic color-shifting bar (Green to Red) and their exact distance (in meters) with a clean, pure white text font.

⚙️ SYSTEM & OPTIMIZATION (ZERO LAG)
Lite-Fullbright: Doesn't blind you with cheap, pure-white screens. It removes shadows and fog, illuminating dark corners like it's broad daylight without straining your eyes.

Custom Dot Cursor: Prevents the game from hiding your mouse when the menu is open. A sleek, Gojo-Purple dot cursor appears on your screen, allowing you to navigate the UI effortlessly.

Event-Based Scanner: Doesn't freeze your PC by constantly scanning the entire map. It only triggers when a new player spawns. Perfect for low-end PCs.

Sleek Watermark: A minimalist UI panel on the right side of your screen showing cheat status, aimbot bind, and active features.

scripts.title: Anti afk
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local VirtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local cooldown = 0
local interval = 55
local enabled = true
local totalPings = 0
local sessionTime = 0

-- Bypass Roblox idle detection
LocalPlayer.Idled:Connect(function()
    VirtualUser:Button2Down(Vector2.new(0, 0), workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame)
    task.wait(0.1)
    VirtualUser:Button2Up(Vector2.new(0, 0), workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame)
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    if not enabled then return end

    cooldown -= dt
    sessionTime += dt

    if cooldown <= 0 then
        cooldown = interval

        -- Method 1: VirtualUser click
        pcall(function()
            VirtualUser:Button2Down(Vector2.new(0, 0), workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame)
            task.wait(0.1)
            VirtualUser:Button2Up(Vector2.new(0, 0), workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame)
        end)

        -- Method 2: Camera CFrame nudge
        pcall(function()
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local cf = cam.CFrame
            cam.CFrame = cf * CFrame.Angles(0, 0.0001, 0)
            task.wait(0.05)
            cam.CFrame = cf
        end)

        -- Method 3: Fake keypress
        pcall(function()
            VirtualUser:KeyDown(string.char(0))
            task.wait(0.05)
            VirtualUser:KeyUp(string.char(0))
        end)

        totalPings += 1
        print("Anti AFK ping " .. totalPings .. " | Session: " .. math.floor(sessionTime / 60) .. "m " .. math.floor(sessionTime % 60) .. "s")
    end
end)

print("Anti AFK loaded — triple bypass active")
print("Will ping every " .. interval .. " seconds")
